title: December watch pre-stage: the 2027 NOT-MET list, expected publication dates, one probe each

gate_rules.payload_date: the served object's own date column must move into the target year/month; a query parameter that echoes is not evidence
gate_rules.value_diff: where a year or month parameter is honoured on the label, diff the values against the prior period's array; identical values with advanced dates are ONE computed generation (the mawaqit trap)
gate_rules.hash_change: for opaque workbooks and PDFs, sha256 against the held artifact; an identical hash is not a new edition

watches.surface: Ministry of Habous monthly JS data file
watches.last_payload_date: 2026-12 absent; control horaires-2026-11.js 200 carrying annee 2026, mois 11, 190 cities
watches.check_detail: GET the file; on 200 parse annee/mois and assert 2026/12 with 190 city rows. Series retention observed this wave: only the current and the previous month exist (2026-01..09 all 404, 2026-10 200 301588 B, 2026-11 200 292088 B), so the December file must be served from the month roll.

watches.surface: Centro Islamico de Chile monthly sheet, 18 city PDFs via radioislam.cl
watches.last_payload_date: December page 404 (510938 B error body); November page 200 with PDFs under uploads/2026/10/
watches.check_detail: Two independent signals. Direct PDF guess https://radioislam.cl/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Diciembre-2026-1.pdf was 404 (1249 B) this wave while the November twin under 2026/10 returned 200 (201911 B), so the upload folder plus filename is a faster gate than the page. The page remains the fallback because the site's REST media API is 401.

watches.surface: Dituria Islame takvimi, WordPress media library
watches.last_payload_date: search=2027 returns []; newest takvim media dated 2026-01-14T10:45:32Z (takvimi2026vaktet.pdf, takvimi2026shkrime.pdf)
watches.check_detail: Publication dates from the media library itself: 2024 edition 2023-12-27, 2023 edition 2022-12-30, 2022 edition 2022-02-14, 2026 edition 2026-01-14. The window is late December to mid January, so a December-1 probe is four weeks early.

watches.surface: SKTHAI (Sheikhul Islam Office) prayer-time workbook page
watches.last_payload_date: reader text carries BE years 2568 and 2569 only, zero occurrences of 2570
watches.check_detail: Direct fetch 403 (5661 B); the reader route returns 200 (19390 B). BE 2570 begins 2027-01-01. Assert a 2570 token and a workbook sha256 absent from the held set; the held 77 workbook hashes are identical to the 2569 edition.

watches.surface: MORA sharepoint OData list Waktu Sembahyang
watches.last_payload_date: newest row 2026-12-30T16:00:00Z = 2026-12-31 local; feed terminates there
watches.check_detail: Assert the newest Date passes 2026-12-31 local. Also re-read the 161-list catalogue for a second prayer list, which the prior wave found absent.

watches.surface: JAKIM e-Solat takwimsolat yearly feed, 59 zones
watches.last_verdict: NOT MET (and the year parameter is a trap)
watches.last_payload_date: both &year=2027 (77257 B) and the plain call (77257 B) return 365 rows opening 01-Jan-2026 and closing 31-Dis-2026; prayerTime arrays byte-equal
watches.check_detail: Never read the echoed year. Read prayerTime[0].date and assert 01-Jan-2027, then re-run for all 59 zones. This wave re-confirmed array equality between the parameterised and plain calls, so the parameter is proven inert on a second date.

watches.last_payload_date: December 2026 rows present (01 Aralik 2026 ... 31 Aralik 2026); zero occurrences of 2027 in the served HTML
watches.check_detail: Assert the yearly table's first row reads 01 Ocak 2027. The ?yil=2027 variant is byte-equal apart from the echoed form action, so the parameter is inert and only the payload counts. awqatsalah.diyanet.gov.tr is a credential-gated landing page, no login attempted.

watches.surface: ACJU prayer-times zone PDFs under wp-content/uploads
watches.last_payload_date: zero uploads/2026/12 references; uploads/2026/11 holds 12 PDFs, all zone 03; 300 references keep the other zones on uploads/2026/10
watches.check_detail: Assert uploads/2026/12 appears, then per zone: 13 zones expected, 12 observed for November. The index page is the only enumeration; uploads are per depot and land in waves, not at one instant.

watches.surface: Centro Cultural Islamico de Madrid monthly PDF
watches.last_payload_date: Diciembre 404 (281863 B error body); Enero..Noviembre 2026 all 200, 317145-415997 B
watches.check_detail: Eleven of twelve 2026 months are served, so the series is continuous and December is a pure lateness. The only Wayback datum for this tree is 2025/Septiembre-2025.pdf captured 2025-09-02, which puts publication at or just after the month start.

watches.surface: Grande Mosquee de Paris monthly poster image
watches.last_payload_date: poster still HEURES PRIERE - PARIS - GMP - NOVEMBRE 2026.jpg; zero DECEMBRE hits
watches.check_detail: Read the poster filename on the live page. Wayback gives the roll pattern: 2026-02-10 carried FEVRIER, 2026-06-09 carried JUIN, 2026-07-11 already carried Juillet. The new poster is therefore live inside the first ten days of its own month. Naming is not stable: the 2026-05-13 capture carried an undated PARIS - GMP.jpg, so match on the month token and fall back to the image hash.

watches.surface: mawaqit.net annual calendar PDF with a year parameter
watches.last_payload_date: ?year=2027 returns 200 with the date column printing 2027-01-01..2027-12-31 while all 365 month-day-aligned prayer rows are identical to the plain 2026 call
watches.check_detail: The payload-date gate PASSES on this surface and is worthless here. Fetch ?year=2027 and the plain call, align by month-day, and require the values to differ on at least one cell before any row is banked. First uuid in the page markup 404s on the calendar route; use the second.

watches.evidence_utc: carried from o1m-31 / o1m-5 blocks, not re-probed this wave
watches.check_detail: The community tail is already MET for the whole of 2027 (api.myquran.com, 365 Jakarta rows banked this round), so this watch is authority-tier only and changes no coverage. Probe the SIHAT month endpoint for January 2027 and read the row dates.

watches.last_payload_date: December link still uploads/2024/06/December-2024.jpg; no 2026 sheet on the site
watches.check_detail: The surface is two years stale, so no publishing cadence can be inferred from it. Probe once in December, then treat repeated failure as a publisher dormancy rather than a watch.

watches.surface: Islamic Foundation of Ireland timetable API
watches.check_detail: Same class as mawaqit and JAKIM. Hash the two responses and diff the arrays; the payload-date gate would pass if the server ever rewrites the dates without recomputing.

watches.last_payload_date: 365 occurrences of 2025 against 2 of 2026; still serving the 2025 roll
watches.check_detail: Count year tokens on the served page and require the dominant year to be the current one before parsing anything.

watches.last_payload_date: the 1448 edition runs 2026/2027 to 2027-06-05; no 1449 edition at the o1m-41 capture date
watches.evidence_utc: carried from o1m-41 block, not re-probed this wave
watches.check_detail: 1449 AH opens at 1 Muharram, which 1 Muharram 1448 plus one lunar year puts at 2027-06-06. The 1449 almanac is therefore a June watch, not a December one: a December probe can only record absence. The 1448 edition already carries January to June 2027, so no 2027 gap exists before it.
